capabilities: Restore each note's cursor and scroll position when it reopens
Navigate back and forward across file switches, tab switches and in-file jumps
List recently visited notes in a sidebar panel or modal
Pin recent notes and filter them by keyword, jumping to matching headings
Exclude notes by folder, line count, image type, or frontmatter property
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian reopens notes at the top without restoring where you were reading or editing, and offers no back/forward history across file switches.

relations.evidence: VSCode-style back / forward across file switches, tab switches and in-file jumps

summary: Navigation plugin that remembers each note's cursor and scroll position, restores it on reopen, and adds back/forward navigation and a recent-files list.
